# Caatinga

> Git-versioned Soroban deploy artifacts and multi-contract orchestration for TypeScript teams.

## Core docs

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): Install, scaffold, CLI-to-browser flow. Start here.
- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): init, setup, doctor, build, deploy, wire, sync-env, generate, status, smoke, regression, ci, identity, invoke, read, zk.
- [Config schema](docs/config.md): `caatinga.config.ts` — contracts, networks, frontend, postDeploy, postDeployRead, smoke, buildRoot.
- [Client API](docs/client.md): `@caatinga/client` — createCaatingaClient, read/simulate/invoke, XDR debug, wallet adapters.
- [Wallets](docs/wallets.md): CaatingaWalletAdapter contract, Stellar Wallets Kit, Freighter, React hooks.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Package layout, data flow, multi-contract DAG, competitive stance. **Product boundary:** Caatinga ends at typed client + resolved contract IDs; HTTP/DB/async are app concerns.
- [Errors](docs/errors.md): Every `CAATINGA_*` code with meaning, common cause, user action.
- [Cheatsheet](docs/cheatsheet.md): Command loop, flags, binding freshness — all on one page.
- [Packages](docs/packages.md): `@caatinga/cli`, `@caatinga/core`, `@caatinga/client`, `@caatinga/zk` — subpath exports.
- [ZK module](docs/zk.md): Circom Groth16 — BLS12-381, dev ceremony, proof, on-chain verification.
- [LLM reference](docs/for-llms.md): Self-contained reference for agents (also at `/llms-full.txt`).

## Tutorials

- [From Zero to Testnet](docs/tutorials/from-zero-to-testnet.md): Full walkthrough — scaffold, deploy, invoke on testnet.
- [Template project](docs/tutorials/template-project.md): `caatinga init` with react-vite-counter.
- [Minimal project](docs/tutorials/minimal-project.md): CLI-only scaffold.
- [ZK project](docs/tutorials/zk-project.md): ZK dApp with Circom/Groth16.
- [Project scaffolds comparison](docs/tutorials/project-scaffolds.md): When to use each path.
- [Multi-contract case study](docs/case-studies/stellar-album.md): dependsOn, postDeploy, wire, sync-env.
- [Testnet hygiene](docs/internal/testnet-hygiene.md): shared testnet state, `useFreshSymbol`, read `--summary`.
- [stellar-build integration](docs/tutorials/integration-guide.md): Optional agent workflow for Claude Code / Codex.

## Full reference

Self-contained API/schema/command/error reference: [docs/for-llms.md](docs/for-llms.md) or [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

Install: `npm install -g @caatinga/cli` (latest **3.6.1**). Alpha pre-1.0 — pin exact versions in CI.
